newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran blasts Israel for opening Jerusalem tunnel.
newsitem.headline: Iran blasts Israel for opening Jerusalem tunnel.

text.p: Iranian state radio blasted Israel on Wednesday for opening a tunnel near a holy Moslem shrine in Jerusalem, saying it showed Arabs they would gain nothing from peace talks with Israel.

"The reason for the relative rise in the Arabs' protests against the expansionist policies of the Zionist regime (Israel) is a belief in the Arab world that one cannot pressure the Zionist regime by using only peaceful means to take back the lost rights of the Arabs," Tehran radio said in a commentary.

The radio was referring to mass protests by Palestinians in Jerusalem and the West Bank on Wednesday against the tourist tunnel opened a day earlier near the al-Aqsa mosque, Islam's third holiest shrine.
At least 130 Palestinians were injured in clashes with Israeli troops on Wednesday.
"The experience of the past few years...(shows that) the Zionist regime has applied its expansionistic policies parallel to proclaiming its demagogical peace policies," it said.
The radio called on the Moslem world to unite in opposing Israel's moves in Jerusalem.
Iran says Israel has no right to exist and condemns peace deals Israel and the Palestinians signed since 1993 as a sellout of Arab rights.
